CLIP (with atom IDs): E09.011 | 00:19.00-00:22.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E09.012 | 00:19.40-00:21.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (venomous, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E09.013 | 00:22.00-00:26.00 | CAM | Close-up on Tobin's jaw tightening.
E09.014 | 00:22.40-00:25.80 | DLG | MARA (pleading, quiet) | "My father built this tower with his own hands."
E09.015 | 00:26.00-00:32.00 | CAM | Low angle on Mara framed against the lighthouse beam.
E09.016 | 00:26.40-00:29.44 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (urgent, kind) | "Your father paid me to watch over you."
E09.017 | 00:30.50-00:32.00 | SFX | Glass shatters on stone.
E09.018 | 00:32.00-00:36.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Tobin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E09.019 | 00:32.40-00:35.44 | DLG | MARA (wary, quiet) | "Tell me the truth, or tell me nothing."
E09.020 | 00:36.00-00:40.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E09.021 | 00:36.20-00:40.00 | ACT | the widow throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.
E09.022 | 00:36.40-00:39.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, triumphant) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E09.023 | 00:40.00-00:45.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E09.024 | 00:40.40-00:41.92 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (furious, venomous) | "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
E09.025 | 00:45.00-00:50.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's hands gripping the rail.
E09.026 | 00:45.20-00:50.00 | ACT | Selene draws a short blade from a boot.
E09.027 | 00:50.00-00:54.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E09.028 | 00:50.20-00:54.00 | ACT | the Mayor kneels on the slick quay boards.
E09.029 | 00:54.00-00:59.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E09.030 | 00:54.40-00:57.82 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (afraid, gruff) | "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
E09.031 | 00:59.00-01:04.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E09.032 | 00:59.40-01:02.06 | DLG | SELENE (mocking, sweet) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E09.033 | 01:04.00-01:10.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Mara's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E09.034 | 01:04.40-01:07.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (furious, silken) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
